release_read.basis: Q3 slightly below the bar (SRS +3.1% vs 3.6% consensus, CAVA revenue $353.7m vs ~$357.4m, EPS $0.11 vs $0.12, RLPM 23.4% in line); FY26 SRS guide raised to 6.0-7.0% but on H1 9.4% + Q3 3.1% that implies Q4 roughly +1% to +5.3% (mid ~3%) against a Street Q4 near 4.5%, RLPM ceiling cut and EBITDA midpoint flat, after a +17% five-day run-up. Call commentary on October not read.

release.headline: CAVA GROUP REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS

vs_bar.consensus_source: Nasdaq EPS forecast (brief fallback), same as Zacks in the hunt
implied from restaurant-level profit $83.8m consensus, stage E-P hunt

key_line.metric: FY26 SRS guide vs Street / implied Q4
key_line.detail: Guide raised to 6.0-7.0% (from 4.5-6.5%). With H1 ~9.4% over 28 weeks and Q3 3.1% over 12, the 52-week range implies Q4 about +1.0% to +5.3%, midpoint ~3%, versus Street Q4 ~4.5% and FY 6.8% (StreetSignal via hunt). Cyclospora cost ~150 bps in Q3; traffic only slightly positive. No quarter-to-date number in the release.

guidance.detail: SRS raised to 6.0-7.0% (Street 6.8% sits inside, above midpoint); openings 76-78 (from 75-77); RLPM narrowed to 23.7-24.0% (top cut from 24.3%); adj EBITDA $184-189m (from $181-191m, midpoint +0.5m); pre-opening costs raised to $28.5-29.5m from $22.0-22.5m.

call.detail: Call held last night at 17:00 ET; transcript not read in the time available, so October/quarter-to-date commentary is unknown. The after-hours low (-13.4%) and partial recovery to about -10% suggests nothing on the call made it worse.

public_reaction.summary: No analyst actions or 2026-11-05 headlines found in one search; results returned 2025 coverage. A Stocktwits article seen in the first search ('plunges 10% after-hours... slashing guidance') carries Q3 2025 numbers and is not about this print.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 55.55 (-10.4% vs prev close 61.98); after hours touched -13.4%, pre-market range 54.24-57.98, last print 09:11, 101 prints, 11 in the last 30 min, not stale. Move is inside the 12.1% implied move but well beyond my -6% release read, so the short's gain already holds more than the release supports. Short entered 63.70, so it is about +12% on the position. QQQ -1.1% adds a little to it.

thesis_check.note: Thesis was a guide/forward read below a Street bar after a 17% run-up: Q3 comps and revenue missed slightly and the raised guide implies a Q4 below the Street's 4.5%. Confirms, but mildly; the guide was raised, not cut.

expected.open_lag_note: Active pre-market (101 prints, last at 09:11, not stale) so the open should hold most of the -10% gap. A double-digit amc gap that already bounced off the after-hours low, a raised headline guide and 13-15% short interest argue for some give-back after the open.

recommendation.reason: De short staat ongeveer 12% in de plus en de koers zakt voorbeurs meer (-10%) dan de cijfers volgens ons rechtvaardigen (ongeveer -6%): het kwartaal was licht zwak, maar de jaarprognose is wel verhoogd. Grote dalingen na cijfers geven vaak een deel terug na de opening, zeker met veel shortposities, dus dek in op de opening, zoals de standaardregel.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de voorbeurskoers voor 09:30 verder wegzakt onder de 54,24 (het voorbeurslaagste) op levendige handel, kan vasthouden tot 10:00 overwogen worden.
